_comment: Device library for INBRAIN Planner. Each entry becomes a preset in the Device parameters section. Units: mm. NX = large-contact columns, NY = rows, PITCH = centre-to-centre spacing, SMALL = record-only small contacts between large ones, STIM_REACH / REC_REACH_L / REC_REACH_S = assumed stimulation / recording reach of large and small contacts.

devices.name: Illustrative 3×7 + 18 array (assumed parameters)
devices.note: Illustrative geometry with assumed values, not an official INBRAIN specification: about 40 contacts in two sizes (about 1 mm and 25 µm), same coverage as the 8 mm wide commercial strip. 3 rows of large contacts in 8 mm gives a 3 mm pitch; 18 micro-contacts sit between neighbouring large contacts along each row (21 + 18 = 39). Recording radii scaled with the pitch.
devices.note_zh: 示意几何，数值为假设，不是 INBRAIN 的官方规格：约 40 个触点、两种尺寸（约 1 mm 和 25 µm），覆盖面积和 8 mm 宽的商用条带相同。8 mm 宽放 3 行大触点，间距 3 mm；每行相邻大触点之间放一个小触点，共 18 个（21 + 18 = 39）。记录半径按间距等比缩小。

devices.name: INBRAIN first-in-human device (12 large + 48 small, layout assumed)
devices.name_zh: INBRAIN 首次人体试验器件（12 大 + 48 小，排布为假设）
devices.note: From the first-in-human interim analysis (Coope 2025, NCT06368310): 12 macro contacts of 1 mm diameter (each made of >700 microelectrodes of 25 µm) and 48 microelectrodes of 25 µm, all nanoporous reduced graphene oxide. The arrangement and spacing are not published: 3 × 4 large contacts at 3 mm (as in the reference material) with the 48 small contacts staggered as in the website photo (a row on each side of every column, offset from the large ones) is an assumption.
devices.note_zh: 按首次人体试验中期分析（Coope 2025，NCT06368310）：12 个直径 1 mm 的大触点（每个由 700 多个 25 µm 微电极组成）和 48 个 25 µm 微电极，材料都是纳米多孔还原氧化石墨烯。排布和间距未公开：按参考资料的 3 mm 间距排成 3 × 4，48 个小触点按官网照片的方式错开排布（每列大触点两侧各一排、与大触点错开），这是假设。

devices.name: INBRAIN 3×7 photo scale (4 mm)
devices.name_zh: INBRAIN 3×7 按官网照片（间距 4 mm）
devices.note: Layout read from the INBRAIN website photo (3×7 large contacts, square grid). Pitch is not public: measured contact diameter / pitch ≈ 0.22, so with the 800 µm upper contact size INBRAIN quotes the pitch is about 3.7 mm. The photo shows about 78 small contacts (two lines per row at half pitch); this preset keeps 12.
devices.note_zh: 排布按 INBRAIN 官网照片（3×7 大触点，方形网格）。间距未公开：照片上触点直径 / 间距约 0.22，按官方说的触点最大 800 µm 换算间距约 3.7 mm。照片上小触点约 78 个（每行上下各一排、半间距），这个预设仍按 12 个算。

devices.name_zh: 商用条带 1×4（4 mm 触点，间距 10 mm）
devices.note: Commercial subdural strip described in the reference material: 4 contacts, 4 mm, platinum or stainless steel, 10 mm spacing, 8 × 52 mm.
devices.note_zh: INBRAIN 参考资料里的商用硬膜下条带：4 触点、直径 4 mm、铂或不锈钢、间距 10 mm、8 × 52 mm。
